title: Enforce strict Solana address validation before Helius
objective: Enforce local, strict 32-byte Base58 Solana address validation before any Live Helius source creation, credential-bearing URL construction, request reservation, or fetch. Apply the same validator to single and manual 1-to-10 CA-first paths and prove invalid inputs make zero source/fetch calls.
forbidden_actions: Do not call Helius or any network provider in tests.
Do not add a provider, fallback, dependency, cron, scheduler, background loop, discovery, persistence, cache, queue, address-library write, BSC or Robinhood behavior.
Do not print, store, commit or record credentials, raw provider payloads, credential-bearing URLs, or arbitrary transport errors.
